dedupe_keys.name: ifpri impact international model for policy analysis of agricultural commodities and trade

description: IMPACT was developed at the International Food Policy Research Institute in the early 1990s to explore long-term challenges in reducing hunger and poverty sustainably. It has been expanded and improved many times for more complex policy questions. Today it is a network of linked economic, water and crop models. At its core is a partial equilibrium multi-market economic model of national and international agricultural markets. The links to water and crop models support joint analysis of environmental, biophysical and socio-economic trends at national, regional and global levels. Coverage is global. IFPRI publishes documentation of the latest update, publications based on IMPACT, and an online visualisation tool with key results. Access terms, licence and programming language are not stated on the page read; the page directs enquiries to the IMPACT model team. Caveats: the provider site blocks non-browser requests, and the model code was not examined. For simulation it projects how climate change, water scarcity and trade or policy shocks change food production, prices and food security, for long-term agricultural resilience scenarios. Related catalogue records include MAgPIE, GLOBIOM, CAPRI, the MapSPAM crop data and the GGCMI outputs.
